title: Returning Borrower Terms: Closing Credit on a New Mortgage Loan File
content:
A customer who has closed an earlier Larkspur loan receives a returning-borrower credit on the initial Closing Disclosure of a new Mortgage Loan File. The credit is read from the date of the most recent funding wire Larkspur sent on any closing of the customer, as shown in the funding wires of the customer's Closing and Funding records (each funding wire sent, with its wire date).

**Terms.** Where that wire was sent less than 36 whole months before the day the Closing Disclosure is prepared, 250.00 USD is added; where it was sent 36 or more whole months before the day the Closing Disclosure is prepared, 100.00 USD is added; where Larkspur has sent no funding wire on any closing of the customer, nothing is added.

Only the most recent wire counts. A wire's age in whole months is the number of calendar months from its wire date to the day the Closing Disclosure is prepared, less one where the day of the month of the preparation day is earlier than that of the wire date.

| Most recent funding wire sent on any closing of the customer | Whole months to the preparation day (hypothetical) | Credit added |
|---|---|---|
| sent 20 August, Closing Disclosure prepared 19 August three years later | 35 | 250.00 USD |
| sent 20 August, Closing Disclosure prepared 20 August three years later | 36 | 100.00 USD |
| most recent wire sent seven years earlier | 84 | 100.00 USD |
| no funding wire sent on any closing of the customer | — | nothing |
